properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 5:13AM CDT until August 9 at 5:45AM CDT by NWS Twin Cities/Chanhassen MN
properties.description:
At 513 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Ceylon, or 11
miles southwest of Fairmont, moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Ceylon around 515 AM CDT.
Fairmont around 535 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by the severe thunderstorm include Wilbert.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing large hail.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 9 at 4:58AM CDT until August 9 at 5:45AM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
SVRDMX

The National Weather Service in Des Moines has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Emmet County in northwestern Iowa...

* Until 545 AM CDT.

* At 457 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Wallingford,
or 6 miles southeast of Estherville, moving northeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Estherville, Okamanpedan Lake, Iowa Lake, Swan Lake, Ingham Lake,
High Lake, Armstrong, Wallingford, Gruver, Dolliver, Fort Defiance
State Park, Okamanpedan State Park, Wolden County Park, and
Estherville Municipal Airport.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
